pages.text: Pick a spot, claim it with $(bold)O$(), and build these as the materials arrive.
A $(bold)Magnum Torch$() stops mob spawns in a big radius. The Diamond one stops hostile mobs. Put one in the middle of the base.
$(bold)Waystones$(): teleport between waystones you have visited. Natural ones spawn in villages; craft your own for home.
$(bold)Simple Storage Network$(): a Storage Network Master, Storage Nodes on your chests, and a Request Table. Every chest in one searchable screen.
$(bold)Elevator$(): stack two elevator blocks in a column. Jump to go up, sneak to go down.
An $(bold)XP Tome$() stores your XP so you never lose it to a death. Fill it before a boss fight.
